'''Monn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] prison guard who lived in [[Slashtown]] Prison Colony on [[Despayre]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was described by [[Celot Ratua Dil]] as being more harsh than [[Nova Stihl]]. He was presumably perished in the [[Destruction of Despayre]].
